_comment: Allowlist for scripts/with_env.py (wrapper syntax: `python3 -I scripts/with_env.py <name>`). The wrapper loads .env and runs the named command outside the Claude Code sandbox, so every entry executes unsandboxed with secrets in its environment. In a host, the agent runs only the absolute line that install.py renders per name into the host's .claude/settings.local.json (sandbox.excludedCommands); a cwd-relative spelling is not excluded and cannot read .env. In the nucleus nothing is rendered and a command that needs a secret is run by the human. The caller supplies a name, never an argv. argv[0] is a path relative to the framework checkout (the directory holding scripts/ and config/); the remaining tokens are literal. `-I` keeps a graphify/ folder in the working directory from shadowing the package. This list is nucleus-only: a host does not extend it (it sits inside .agents/, which is write-denied to a host) and proposes an addition upstream through agents.md section 4 feedback_upstream. pytest is not listed because it executes agent-written code.

graphify-extract.reason: graphify semantic extraction reads its provider key from the environment only (graphifyy 0.8.30 has no .env loader)

graphify-extract-deep.reason: deep semantic extraction, same provider-key requirement

graphify-label.reason: community labelling through the provider, same provider-key requirement
